question: What range of reality must be encompassed when meditating on that presence in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation is that presence.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate on that presence in every place as pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, one should contemplate it as extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
